## About
Tire Discount House is a neighborhood tire and auto shop on Van Born Rd in Dearborn Heights. We sell new and used tires from major brands, and we handle wheel alignments and brake service for cars, vans and light trucks.
We're a member of the Greater Dearborn Chamber of Commerce and serve the greater Dearborn area. One reviewer wrote about talking directly with the owner, Rick Bixman, and getting in the next day. We hold a 4 star rating from 143 Google reviews.

## Services
- New and used tires: Need to replace worn-out tires? We carry new and used tires from major brands.
- Wheel alignments: Front end and four wheel alignments on cars, vans and light trucks.
- Brake service: Disc, drum and anti-lock brake systems. Come in for a free safety brake check.

## FAQ
Q: Is there Wi-Fi while I wait?
A: Yes, we offer free Wi-Fi at the shop.
